note: Wood species uses v1 (Dave 2026-10-23, tech/items/TREE_SPECIES_USES_V1.md). class: hardwood logs saw into Hardwood boards, softwood and the plain Log into Planks (one Firewood and one Wooden block for every species since Dave 15 Nov 2026, docs/design/TREE_WOOD_TOOLS_DESIGN.md). burn 1-5 (firewood). hits_to_fell is a reference: the server already derives hits from trunk thickness (thin hardwood fewer, thick softwood more); axe wear per hit is the same for every species. Foundations ignore the rot rules. Species not listed use hardwood defaults.

ingredient_groups.note: An ingredient id that names a group (a recipe asking for plain log) is filled by any member. The crafting code matches members; validate_items checks every group has members and that no recipe needs a plain id with no source. Defined by Sal 2026-10-31 for guide finding F-16; code half in LOG_SPECIES_SPEC.md. nails and hinges (Morgan, 10 Nov 2026): bronze or iron fills every blueprint and recipe that asks for them; iron bands stay iron. copper_nails (Dave 15 Nov 2026, the Quality - Backpack takes any nails): a need for Copper nails is filled by copper, bronze or iron nails; Copper nails are not in the nails group, so a building's nails cost and its refund are unchanged. Mission 001 phase 2a (master s2.3, s4 item 3): log_spruce (Softwood log: spruce, Scots pine, the plain Log) makes Planks and log_oak (Hardwood log: the six hardwood species) makes Hardwood boards; the two never substitute [D4]. The retired species logs left the log group.

tree_sap.note: Dave 16 Nov 2026: you get Tree sap whenever you cut down a softwood tree (a species with class softwood below) or process softwood logs (the log_spruce group: Spruce log, Scots pine log, the plain Log) into anything. item is the Tree sap item (id resin, the conifer sap that was named Resin). felled: how many every felled softwood tree gives, small or large, beside the trunk; per_softwood_log: how many each softwood log a finished craft used up gives the crafter. Amounts PROVISIONAL (TORCH-SAP TS-2, TS-3).

group_labels.note: Master s4 item 14: a group cost reads under this label, not its key item's name (item_table.gd cost_name).

retired_to.note: Master s4 item 3. Data only; renames.json is the live mechanism, and Dynasty is a new game (Dave 12 Nov 2026), so no rename rows are needed.

birch.best_use: fine boards, firewood, bark for twine and tar

tropical_hardwood.best_use: Hardwood boards (Mission 001 phase 2a: it is in the Hardwood log group, so it chops and burns as hardwood too)
